author: Nova I
title: Use shared plotting helper — f1 bar + v2.5 rolling
abstract: Imports plot_quickstart and saves two figures: f1 per-agent bars and v2.5 rolling (persistence).

original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json
sys.path.append("storage/shared")  # so 'agency_lab.utilities' is importable
from agency_lab.utilities.plot_quickstart import bar_f1_per_agent, line_v25_rolling

OUT_DIR = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/figures"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

res1 = bar_f1_per_agent(
  "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv/f1_per_agent.csv",
  os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "helper_f1_per_agent_persistence.png")
)
print("F1_RESULT", json.dumps(res1, indent=2))

res2 = line_v25_rolling(
  "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv/joint_metrics_v2_5_per_lineage_rolling.csv",
  os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "helper_v2_5_rolling_persistence.png"),
  value_field="persistence_rate"
)
print("ROLLING_RESULT", json.dumps(res2, indent=2))
